verdict.rationale: Fin is itself the built-in AI agent: teams hand it customer queries, and it handles multi-step queries end to end, takes actions that update external systems, and runs trained Procedures across business logic and third-party systems. Copilot is mentioned only in passing as a teammate-facing assistant, so ad-hoc delegation by an internal user is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: detailed docs on internal users delegating ad-hoc tasks to an in-product assistant (Copilot/Operator), independent hands-on corroboration of task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Procedures let you train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish.
Takes action to update external systems
Fin resolves 76% of customer queries on average, and handles multi-step queries end to end.
so Fin, Copilot, and your team always work from the same source of truth
